Hi Liam —

Thanks for sending those over. Quick summary of what's outstanding from Redwood Procurement to clear the activation hold: 

Required items (must be provided or confirmed):
1) Certificate of Insurance with Additional Insured endorsement naming: Redwood Inference, Inc. (and affiliates) — exact wording in the link below.
2) Waiver of Subrogation: required for US-based services; please confirm if your insurer can add the endorsement.
3) W-9 (vendor tax form) — we didn't see it attached; please send w9-argosys-signed.pdf.
4) Subcontractor roster (if you engage subcontractors for any portion of work) — CSV or PDF with company name, service provided, and country.
5) Evidence of cyber liability limits if applicable — if you have a standalone cyber policy, please include limits summary.

Conditional PO option: Procurement can issue a conditional PO that allows limited staging (up to 30 days) if COI + claims history are provided and a confirmed timeline for endorsement is given. Final invoice payment and full activation require the endorsement and W-9 on file.

I've linked the standard endorsement language and the PO onboarding checklist here: https://app.redwood.example/documents/PO-2026-1123

I'll loop in Priyom to confirm the conditional PO terms and Marissa for billing routing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Liam / Argosys team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the W-9. Next steps and proposed roadmap from Redwood Procurement and Finance: 

1) Conditional PO staging proposal (Procurement):
   - Scope: dev and staging environments only (no production access).
   - Cap: $10,000 cap for the first 30 days while endorsement is processed.
   - Reporting: weekly usage summary to procurement@redwood.example.

2) Requirements to move to full activation:
   - Endorsement with Additional Insured language applied to the policy and updated COI provided.
   - Waiver of Subrogation confirmed by insurer for US coverage.
   - Completed subcontractor roster delivered as CSV.

3) Timeline expectations:
   - You indicated 5–7 business days for the endorsement. Procurement will provision the conditional PO within 24 hours of us receiving a written ETA from your broker. Full activation will be scheduled the business day after we receive the updated COI + endorsements.

4) Billing / invoicing routing (Marissa):
   - Marissa, please confirm the invoice workflow and if any additional billing fields are required on Argosys invoices.

5) Risk exceptions (Connor):
   - Connor, our Risk team may request proof of cyber limits if Argosys processes customer data. Please flag any subcontractors that will have access to customer data.

If Argosys agrees to the conditional PO terms above, please reply with broker ETA and attach the subcontractor CSV. We'll draft the conditional PO and send the DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/argosys/onboarding-ack

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
